name: The Vibecoder
description: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, aider, and the terminal helpers for building with AI.

items.name: claude-code
items.summary: Anthropic terminal coding agent that edits code from natural language.

items.name: codex
items.summary: OpenAI terminal coding agent that reads, edits, and runs code.

items.name: opencode
items.summary: Open source terminal coding agent that works across model providers.

items.name: gemini-cli
items.summary: Google open source terminal agent backed by Gemini models.

items.name: aider
items.summary: Terminal pair programmer that edits files in your git repo through chat.

items.name: zellij
items.summary: Terminal multiplexer with panes, tabs, layouts, and session resurrection.

items.name: glow
items.summary: Terminal markdown renderer for files, stdin, and URLs.

items.name: git-delta
items.summary: Syntax-highlighting pager for git diff, show, and blame.

items.name: mods
items.summary: Sends command output and prompts to a language model and prints markdown.
